reviews.title: I wish I could rate it higher
reviews.text:
This game is well-designed, and runs smoothly.

But the Chinese letters (words?) throw me off. I don’t read Chinese, so I get confused and frustrated when there’s more than one pair in a puzzle.

No letters or words, please. The pictures of everyday objects do just fine.

reviews.title: Super Easy and Stress Free!
reviews.text:
I’ve just downloaded this game in 2023, only had it for about a week.

Well I can say it’s one of my favorites so far.  I love that it’s ad free which makes gaming a lot more enjoyable.  Nothings worse than when a game you love is over inundated by ads and the only way to stop that is to pay for them to stop.  I’m sorry but NO game is getting my money especially since I don’t make any money to play.

If you’re reading these reviews know that this game is worth it and quiet unlike the ones that have ads where it’s quiet until the loud ads pop up.
This is helping an older lady with her lack of memory get one! Thanks!!!
